rationale: The SAIA 2.3.6 feature guide requires Platform 10.1.x+, supported AWS service regions and enabled Model Runtime; the Cloud Connected section describes the 2.1.x+ app threshold and certificate and management-port requirements. The install guide and SAIA-9918 still exclude versions 2.2.0–2.3.6 for Cloud Connected, with 2.1.1 a workaround that lacks Agent Mode and 2.4.0 described as planned. Model Runtime lists Frankfurt as Data zone, Dublin as Global, and conditional prompt delivery outside the Splunk data boundary. Base-assistant or limited IL2 evidence supplies no authorization or usable current CMP Agent Mode path.

exclusions: No supported Cloud Connected 2.4.0 release or tenant availability is established.
